name: stagecraft
description: Advanced playground for Playwright testing framework
author: Orhun Akkan

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev --workspace=client" "npm run dev --workspace=server"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=client && npm run test --workspace=server
scripts.test:run: npm run test:run --workspace=client && npm run test:run --workspace=server
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace=client && npm run test:coverage --workspace=server
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=client && npm run lint --workspace=server
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspace=client && npm run typecheck --workspace=server
